# Cameo — account brief

## Who

Cameo describes itself as "Cameo | Personalized videos from your favorite stars — Book personalized video messages from actors, athletes, musicians, and other celebrities." ([source](https://cameo.com/)). The GitHub org profile lists cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- react-native 0.74.5 in cameo/cameo-app/package.json ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- CI workflows exist in cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- 31 public repos and 240 followers on github.com/cameo ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).
- cameo/cameo-app last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)).
- 95,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).
- 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@cameo-maintainer-1), 203 commits, top contributor to cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@cameo-maintainer-2), 151 commits, top contributor to cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@cameo-maintainer-3), 77 commits, top contributor to cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Cameo" and website https://cameo.com ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

cameo/cameo-app last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)), and the app shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). The repo runs react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One, you have 203 commits in cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo-maintainer-1)), which carries both an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)) and CI workflows under .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)). The app has shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). Across those four releases, what does the handoff between your .github/workflows CI and the EAS build actually look like?
